title: B195 — Store the Linear team intake email as a secret (scripts/.env + SealedSecret)
description:
## Why

Linear's team **intake email** (Team settings → General → Create issues by email) is enabled. It is a capability address: anyone who has it can file issues into the team with no authentication, and this repo is **public**. It is B184's alert → Linear fallback (an Alertmanager email receiver), so it needs a durable, sealed home before anything uses it — not a screenshot or a UI field. Found in the B119 settings walk (2026-09-26).

## Scope

1. The owner adds `LINEAR_INTAKE_EMAIL` to the gitignored `scripts/.env` (the value is never pasted into chat, commits, issues or docs).
2. Create the Secret from `.env` — `monitoring` namespace (Alertmanager's), name `linear-intake`, key `LINEAR_INTAKE_EMAIL` — and add `monitoring/linear-intake` to the `SECRETS=(…)` allow-list in `scripts/seal-secrets.sh`, then seal per `docs/runbooks/secrets.md` § "Add a NEW secret to the sealed set".
3. Record it in the secrets index (`docs/runbooks/secrets.md`) with the rotation step: the refresh control beside the address in Linear → update `.env` → re-seal.

## Technical context

| Where | What | Role |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Linear | Team settings → General → Create issues by email | the value (and its rotate control) |
| rogueone | `scripts/.env` (gitignored) — `LINEAR_INTAKE_EMAIL` | local source of truth |
| mother | Secret `monitoring/linear-intake` → SealedSecret in `k8s/sealed-secrets/sealed/` | cluster copy for Alertmanager |
| repo | `scripts/seal-secrets.sh` allow-list, `docs/runbooks/secrets.md` | sealing + index |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `LINEAR_INTAKE_EMAIL` is set in `scripts/.env` and nowhere else in the working tree (a repo-wide search for the address returns nothing).
- [ ] The Secret exists; its stored value length matches `.env` (verify the stored value, not just `DATA 1` — per the lab's verify-secret-after-create rule).
- [ ] The SealedSecret is committed and Argo reports it Synced; the plain Secret is never committed.
- [ ] The secrets runbook lists it with its rotation step.

## Edge cases & failure modes

* An empty or truncated value is accepted silently by Kubernetes → verify the stored length.
* Leaked address → rotate in Linear, update `.env`, re-seal; the old address stops working.
* The placeholder guard (B147) must not flag a real value as a placeholder or pass a placeholder as real.

## Out of scope

* Wiring the Alertmanager email receiver itself (that is B184's fallback path, only if the incident tool doesn't cover alert → issue).
* Any other Linear credential.

Relates B184 ([EMA-242](https://linear.app/emangini/issue/EMA-242/b184-adopt-slack-free-audit-every-slack-integration-across-the)), B69 (SealedSecrets), B119.
